strings.뭘유. 그럼 말씀해주세유…. 아, 이거 내 말투 아닌데…. 하여튼, 그냥: Ain't nothin'. Tell me what... Wait, that's not how I talk... Anyway, I couldn't just pass by.
strings.고마우이. 자네가 도움을 준 덕분에 산의 정기가 어느 정도 돌아오긴 헜지: Thank you kindly. Your help restored some of the mountain's essence, but it still ain't enough.
strings.자네, 그거 아나? 이 괴물나무 산이 미르간디아에 흐르는 자연의 힘의 중: Did you know? Monster Tree Mountain is the heart of the natural power flowing through Mirgandia.
strings.잘은 모르겠지만, 정기가 부족하면 미르간디아가 오염될 수 있는 확률이 높: Not really, but a shortage of essence means Mirgandia is more likely to become corrupted?
strings.맞구먼. 산의 정기를 좀 더 맑고 깨끗하게 가득 펼칠 수 있는 방법이 필: That's right. We need a way to spread more pure, clean essence through the mountain. Then this place will be safer.
I'll help Iris become a more complete god.
strings.여신님은 여신님 대로 고충이 있으니께 너무 몰아붙이진 말여. 자네는 날: The goddess has troubles of her own. Don't push her too hard. Just help me a little.
strings.원래 바위 위에 힘을 부여해 꽃을 피우면 산을 중심으로 정기가 깨끗해지는: Used to be, if I put power into flowers blooming on the rocks, the mountain's essence would clear right up. But pollution's piled up over time, and now all this trouble...
strings.단순히 꽃만으로는 할 수 없게 된 거구먼. 혹시 연구를 많이 하는 마법사: Flowers alone won't do it anymore. If you know a mage who does plenty of research, go ask for advice.
A mage who does a lot of research...
strings.잘은 모르지만, 자네가 방문했던 도시 중에 마법에 욕심이 많은 이가 있던: I don't know much, but I reckon one of the cities you visited had someone mighty keen on magic.
strings.아, 맞아요. 있어요. 그런데 그건 어떻게 아셨어요?: Oh, yes. There is someone. How did you know?
strings.땅에 오래 있다보니 땅으로 흘러 들어오는 정보가 조금 있재. 후후. 정령: Spend long enough with the earth, and you hear a few things through it. Hehe. A spirit's power, you might say.
Ah, listen to me ramble... This isn't urgent. Take your time.
strings.아, 그리고 말여. 내가 누구란 건 말허지 말고. 웬 노인네가 산이 오염: And don't tell them who I am. Just say some old fellow's troubled by a polluted mountain and needs help. Understood?
strings.(펄스가 앞에 사람이 있는 줄도 모르고 책을 읽고 있다.): (Pulse reads a book, unaware anyone is standing before him.)
What is it? I'm absorbed in a new book. You're interrupting.
strings.연구에 도움이 될만한 일을 들고 왔을지도 모르는데요?: I may have brought something useful for your research.
Then I'll hear it and decide.
strings.(라피뎀의 부탁대로 어떤 노인이 자신의 산이 오염돼 마법의 힘으로 정화하: (As Lapidem requested, you explain that an old man wants magic to cleanse his polluted mountain.)
If it needs magical assistance, it can't be an ordinary mountain.
strings.자연을 정화하는 마법 연구라…. 한번 해보고 싶었는데, 이렇게 기회가 올: Research into magic that purifies nature... I've wanted to try that. What an opportunity.
strings.제가 해볼 테니 연구에 필요한 특수 재료를 구해주시기 바랍니다. 일반적인: I'll undertake it. Please fetch the special materials I need. For ordinary work, the gems here would suffice, but...
strings.조합과 융합이 필요한 연구입니다. 일종의 연금술 같은 느낌이 들 수 있겠: This requires combination and fusion. You might call it a form of alchemy.
strings.기록에 의하면 <저주받은 심장>이라고 생명의 힘을 제어할 수 있는 물건이: Records mention an object called a <Cursed Heart>, capable of controlling the power of life.
strings.이스트랜드의 사막 어딘가에 있다고 하는 것 같은데…. 일단 재료를 가져오: Apparently, it can be found somewhere in an Eastland desert... Let's talk once you've brought it.
Oh, I know where. A little troublesome, but...
I'll wait. This should be interesting research.
You've obtained the material. Well done.
strings.보기만 해도 신비한 느낌의 물건이군요. 그럼 잠시만 기다려주셨으면 합니다: An object that looks mysterious at a glance. Please wait a moment.
strings.(펄스가 옅은 웃음을 보이며 재료를 들고 어디론가 사라진다.): (With a faint smile, Pulse takes the material and disappears somewhere.)
He's acting differently than usual. He really does love magical research.
strings.(펄스가 사라진 골목에서 갑자기 엄청난 폭발음이 일어난다.): (An enormous explosion suddenly erupts from the alley where Pulse disappeared.)
strings.저기 분명 펄스가 들어간 건물이었는데…,: That's the building Pulse went into...
strings.(폭발의 여파로 엉망이 된 모습이 된 펄스가 천천히 걸어나온다.): (Pulse slowly emerges, a disheveled mess from the explosion.)
I'm fine... But I don't know where the research went wrong.
I accounted for every variable, even the flow of mana, yet it failed... I'm ashamed.
And I ruined the material you brought...
strings.아닙니다. 지금 한다고 해도 제 결과는 여전히 폭발로 이어질 것 같습니다: No. If I tried again now, the result would still be an explosion. Sigh...
strings.솔직히 패닉 상태입니다. 인정하기 싫지만, 저보다 그 사람이 어울리는 답: Frankly, I'm panicking. I hate to admit it, but someone else might offer a better answer.
strings.루맨에서 오셨으니 아실테지만, 그 사람이 아스마 양입니다. 가셔서 펄스가: Since you're from Lumen, you'll know her: Asma. Go and ask her. Just tell her Pulse said he was sorry.
strings.그냥 그렇게 전하면 되나요?: That's all I need to say?
strings.네, 그것 뿐입니다. 원래는 이런 일을 잘 하지 않는 아스마 양이지만,: Yes, nothing more. She doesn't usually take on such work, but she'll do it for me. Though she'll probably show an unusual expression...
If you say so, I'll go see her.
strings.네, 감사합니다. 그럼 전 폭발로 어지럽혀진 방을 정리해야겠습니다. 그냥: Thank you. I'd better clean up the room after that explosion. If I leave it, who knows what lecture Melvic will give me...
strings.네, 안녕하세요. 아스마. 다름이 아니라 오늘도 부탁할 일이 있어서 왔어: Hello, Asma. I've come with another favor to ask.
strings.(순간 아스마의 얼굴이 굳은 것 같은데….): (Her face seemed to freeze for a moment...)
strings.(아스마에게 어떤 노인이 자신의 산이 오염돼 마법의 힘으로 정화하고 싶은: (You tell Asma that an old man needs help using magic to purify his polluted mountain.)
Pulse says he's sorry he couldn't handle it.
That isn't what he's sorry for. Don't worry about it.
strings.(분명 분위기가 갑자기 싸늘해졌지. 그냥 조용히 해야지.): (The atmosphere definitely turned chilly. I'd better stay quiet.)
strings.자세하게 설명해 드리긴 애매하지만, 모험가님이 그 재료를 받으면서 살짝: It's difficult to explain precisely, but the material seems to have changed a little when you took possession of it.
strings.모험가님이 지닌 힘이 일반적인 상태를 벗어나서 재료 또한 영향을 받은 것: Your power is outside the ordinary range. It seems to have affected the material as well.
Oh... So it was my fault. I'm the one who should apologize to Pulse.
strings.신경 쓰지 마세요. 이미 펄스도 알고 있을 거예요. 자신의 이론이 틀리진: Don't worry. He probably realizes it already. His theory wasn't wrong; he simply discovered the variable called 'you' too late.
strings.대신 재료를 구해서 저에게 가져다주세요. 먼저 <활력나무의 뿌리>와 <초: Instead, bring me some materials. First, a <Vitality Tree Root> and <Tears of Vegetation>.
Well done. These actually aren't for improving the mountain's essence.
strings.일단 들어보세요. 새로운 재료를 구해서 산으로 간다고 해도, 가는 중에: Hear me out. Even if you gathered fresh materials and headed for the mountain, your condition might ruin them on the way.
strings.그런 변화를 막는 일종의 약을 만들어 드릴게요. 그리 오래 걸리지 않을: I'll make a medicine to prevent that change. It won't take long.
strings.(안으로 들어갔던 아스마가 약 봉투를 들고 나타난다.): (Asma goes inside, then returns with a packet of medicine.)
strings.먹고 이상하게 되는 건 아니겠죠?: It won't do anything strange to me, will it?
The theory is perfect, so don't worry. Hehe.
That makes me more nervous. Sigh... I'll take it.
strings.어, 맛있는데? 무슨 약에서 고기 맛이 나지?: Oh, it's good. Why does medicine taste like meat?
That's a relief. If there'd been side effects, it would have tasted different.
Hehe. Don't worry about it. Anyway, we need more materials.
strings.고기 맛이니 용서할게요. 후우…. 그래서 더 구해야 하는 재료가 뭔가요?: Since it tastes like meat, I'll forgive you. Sigh... What else do you need?
strings.메린 섬에 있는 어떤 던전에서 <정령의 영혼>과 아말룬 사막의 '안식의: Get a <Spirit's Soul> from a dungeon on Merin Island, and an <Origin of Wind> from the Hall of Rest in the Amaloon Desert.
strings.모험가님은 다 하실 수 있을 거예요. 물건을 다 모으셨다면 정령 어르신에: You can manage it. Once you have everything, take it to the elderly spirit.
strings.네, 미르에게 들었어요. 가끔 육포 가지러 오곤 하는데, 그때 절 만나고: Yes. Mir told me. Sometimes Mir visits for jerky and stops by to chat. The elderly spirit came up in conversation.
I heard he was worried about making the mountain cleaner, so I'd been looking into it.
Thank you. That makes things much easier.
strings.뭘요. 모험가님이 하시는 일이 모두 대륙과 세계를 위한 일이니 돕는 게: Of course. Your work is for the continent and the world. Helping is only natural.
I felt a powerful presence from the mountain entrance and wondered who it was. It's you.
strings.자네가 들고 있는 물건들이 나한테 도움이 되겄군. 내 앞에 좀 놓아줄텨?: Those things you're carrying will help me. Set them down here, would you?
strings.알려준 사람이 이 물건들을 모아 라피뎀 님에게 가져가면 된다고 그러더군요: The person who advised me said to gather these and bring them to you, Lapidem.
strings.뭐여? 나를 알고 있는 마법사가 있는겨?: What? There's a mage who knows me?
strings.(라피뎀에게 미르가 아스마를 만나 그런 이야기를 했다고 전한다.): (You explain that Mir told Asma about Lapidem.)
strings.내가 미르 그 아이가 올 때 말여. 이 산의 정기가 어쩌구 저쩌구 이야기: When Mir visited, I went on about the mountain's essence. That child remembered.
strings.참 기특혀. 다음에 올 때 산의 아이들에게 뭔가 맛있는 걸 준비하라고 해: What a good child. I'll tell the mountain's little ones to prepare something tasty for the next visit.
strings.그나저나 이런 걸 알려준 마법사도 참 대단혀. 자네는 운도 좋고, 인복도: And the mage who figured this out is impressive, too. You're lucky, with good people around you. Treasure them.
Then I'll put my power into these things.
strings.(라피뎀 앞에 있던 재료 위로 어디선가 바람이 불어온다. 이내 바람은 날: (A wind blows over the materials before Lapidem. It sharpens, crushing them into powder.)
strings.(가루가 된 재료들은 바람에 실려 허공 위에 반짝거리며 산을 비롯해 미르: (The powdered materials rise glittering on the wind, spreading across the mountain and all of Mirgandia.)
I'm grateful. This is the duty the goddess gave me.
I hope nothing else troubles this world...
I'm sure it'll be fine. I'll go finish my remaining work.
You may not know it, but there's much still ahead of you. Be careful...
